text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum underperforming slightly, signaling mild risk-off sentiment as traders consolidate near round levels. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral 51 but has declined 17 points over a week, pointing to erosion in conviction and a shift toward caution. Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 59.5% suggests capital is rotating into the largest asset rather than flowing into alts, typical of periods when confidence is wavering.
